integrity: Analytic proof and independently reproducible symbolic and finite-chain checks; numerical truncations supplement but do not prove all-state identities.
scientific_limitations: Finite two-site symmetric immigration-death-migration model only; independent rate-r whole-site clearings; stationary positive second moments, not a general network theorem. Literature overlap with broad queueing recursions is a residual priority risk.
title: A unique synchronization optimum from independent local catastrophes on two hopping sites
